destination.name: Port Pirie
destination.tagline: Spencer Gulf port city with a big smelter, murals and heritage trails
destination.description: Port Pirie is a port city on Spencer Gulf, home to the Nyrstar smelter, whose chimney is visible from miles around. A self-guided heritage trail links more than 30 sites, and a mural trail and the National Trust museum add more of the city's story. The long wooden Port Germein Jetty, Telowie Gorge and Beetaloo Reservoir all lie within a short drive.

goodToKnow.title: See the smelter across the river
goodToKnow.detail: The best view is from the far side of the Port Pirie River, over the bridge off the main street.

goodToKnow.title: Pick up a trail map
goodToKnow.detail: Heritage trail maps are free from the visitor information centre and online.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Visit in {months} for mild weather that suits walking the heritage and mural trails.
